question: Give the distribution of answers to `kn_definition` across all 15 agreements as an object mapping every standard option of that deal point (include options with count 0) to the number of agreements (each agreement counts once).

How many of the 15 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_noshop_rep_liability` = «Yes» AND NOT (`dp_cor_match_additional` = «3 business days»)? Answer with an integer.

How many of the 15 agreements satisfy ALL of the following: `dp_so_stock_threshold` = «Greater than 50% but not "all or substantially all"» AND NOT (`dp_so_asset_threshold` = «50%»)? Answer with an integer.

List every agreement that satisfies: `dp_cor_so_standard` = «"Reasonably likely/expected to be inconsistent" with fiduciary duties» AND `dp_so_fpov_sole` = «Yes». If no agreement qualifies, answer with an empty list [].

For `gen_consideration`, list every agreement whose answer is shared by at most 2 of the 15 agreements (counting the agreement itself).
For `kn_identified_persons`, list every agreement whose answer is shared by at most 1 of the 15 agreements (counting the agreement itself).
